source: Deadlock Counter Buying Guide web guide v0.8 (extracted 2026-11-26)

heroes.name: Abrams
heroes.note: Siphon Life drains HP from everyone nearby — he wins long brawls by out-healing your damage.

heroes.name: Apollo
heroes.note: Riposte no longer triggers off bullets — it reflects them; only abilities and items trigger it. Pommel Hit no longer disarms — it knocks you up, slows you 50% and blocks stamina for 2s.

heroes.name: Baba
heroes.note: S-tier frontliner. Baba's Brew cycles barrier, silence and burn; Threadsap now lasts 10s (was 16s) and her Spirit Resist scaling was cut again on 26 Nov. Feed The Birds hits harder (max damage 650) but Indomitable now blocks the pigeon.

heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.note: One Grapple Arm hook makes it a 5v6. His Hyper Beam is a channel — it can be interrupted.

heroes.name: Billy
heroes.note: Chain Gang drags you into a brawl on his terms. Complexity-3 chaos pick who disrupts grouped teams.

heroes.name: Calico
heroes.note: Burst assassin with a cat companion (Ava) amplifying her damage. Squishy if you survive the first combo.

heroes.name: Celeste
heroes.note: Dazzling Trick silences you; Radiant Daggers stack Spirit Amp. Her ult and silence were nerfed on 4 Nov, but the burst is still real.

heroes.name: Deadman Danny
heroes.note: Chimera Mk1 jetpack keeps him airborne, and Close The Deal carries one enemy into the sky — execute bonus cut to +55% on 4 Nov.

heroes.name: The Doorman
heroes.note: Doorway links two points of the map and Hotel Guest removes a target to the Baroness Hotel — fights start and end where he wants.

heroes.name: Drifter
heroes.note: Roaming hybrid assassin who picks off isolated targets and slips away. Punish him when his mobility is spent.

heroes.name: Dynamo
heroes.note: Singularity pulls your whole team into one spot — the best teamfight ult in the game. Rejuvenating Aurora keeps his team healed through it.

heroes.name: Graves
heroes.note: Highest win rate in Nov 2026 (57.1%). Lock-on gun, ghoul summons that push lanes while he's somewhere else. Low mobility, low burst.

heroes.name: Grey Talon
heroes.note: Long-range bow poke with spirit-scaled damage. Deadly from distance, folds when dived.

heroes.name: Haze
heroes.note: Sleep Dagger into a point-blank Bullet Dance. The only gun build among Nov's top-hero tables — and she hunts isolated targets.

heroes.name: Holliday
heroes.note: Catch-and-burst initiator with drone utility. Demanding kit, but a landed catch usually means a kill.

heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.note: Afterburn burns you over time and Napalm's T2 lifesteal (20% since 30 Oct) keeps him alive while he dives. Concussive Combustion stuns after a 3.25s delay.

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.note: Kudzu Connection tethers an ally; Air Drop flies a teammate in — or drops a Stone Form on your head. Saves and engages from the sky.

heroes.name: Kelvin
heroes.note: Frozen Shelter domes his whole team. Top-tier support win rate in Nov 2026 — fights inside his dome are fights on his terms.

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.note: 56.5% win rate, #2 in Nov 2026 (+2.4 pts after the 4 Nov patch). Life Drain tethers and heals her for 100% of the damage; Soul Exchange swaps her health with yours.

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.note: Death Slam comes from directly above. Aerial engage you often don't see until you're already displaced.

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.note: Mini Turrets aim for her (65% damage vs troopers since 30 Oct), Medicinal Specter heals, and Heavy Barrage is an 8-second homing rocket channel. Very slow, very immobile.

heroes.name: Mina
heroes.note: Love Bites stack on gun hits, Rake slashes and heals her, Nox Nostra's bat swarm silences. Oppressive lane, glass cannon.

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.note: Traveler was reworked on 30 Oct — now a 3s channel that stuns, roots and Slowing Hex can interrupt. Worst win rate in Nov 2026 (43.1%); pressure him, don't fear him.

heroes.name: Mo & Krill
heroes.note: Scorn heals him 1.3× from heroes (buffed 4 Nov) and Burrow engages from underground. Combo permanently gains +50 HP per kill.

heroes.name: Nurse Harrow
heroes.note: Leech Therapy drains you to feed her team, and Lurking Terrors fears anyone looking at her — fear buildup cut to 1.75s and her gun buffed +8% on 4 Nov. Warden is immune to the fear.

heroes.name: Paige
heroes.note: 56.4% win rate, top-3 support in Nov 2026. Plot Armor saves an ally and buffs their damage on one button. Low mobility, low burst — catch her, not her carry.

heroes.name: Paradox
heroes.note: Paradoxical Swap trades places with you — usually into his whole team. One swap is a death sentence if you're out of position.

heroes.name: Pocket
heroes.note: Zone control and burst, but bottom-tier win rate in Nov 2026. Punish the long cooldowns after his combo.

heroes.name: Rat King
heroes.note: Rule, Ratannia! gives his whole team damage reduction — the ult has been nerfed three patches running, but he is still a tanky spreadshot carry.

heroes.name: Rem
heroes.note: Sleep and dream utility with team saves. Complexity 3, and the opposite of Warden's clock — Rem gets better the longer the game goes.

heroes.name: Seven
heroes.note: Storm Cloud is a channelled, expanding storm (205s). The purest late-game carry: weak early, no mobility, and his ult can be CC'd out of.

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.note: Bloodletting turns damage taken into a rage-fuelled brawl he sustains through. Kiting him beats trading with him.

heroes.name: Silver
heroes.note: Simple long-range brawler tank. Stands in front, soaks damage, shoots back.

heroes.name: Sinclair
heroes.note: Audience Participation copies an enemy ult for 9s — he is only as strong as the ult he steals. Rabbit Hex turns you into a rabbit for 2s. The game's only complexity-4 hero.

heroes.name: Solomon
heroes.note: Chessboard zoning: bishops, Rook Battery, knights that shield allies, and Develop Queen, which now checkmates targets under 100 HP. His gun was nerfed hard on 30 Oct.

heroes.name: Venator
heroes.note: Crossbow carry with merciless single-target damage. A precision duellist — miss your engage and he deletes you.

heroes.name: Victor
heroes.note: Shocking Reanimation brings him back swinging — killing him once is not killing him. Forgiving pistol carry with heavy sustain.

heroes.name: Vindicta
heroes.note: Flies above the fight and assassinates from long range. Anything that grounds her makes her a normal, squishy sniper.

heroes.name: Violet
heroes.note: Living Ink paints walls that block heroes and projectiles; Abstract Landscape silences anyone who leaves the ring. Huge late scaling, highest skill ceiling of the October heroes.

heroes.name: Viscous
heroes.note: The Cube encases an ally or enemy — saving his carry or removing yours. Goo bounce disrupts grouped teams.

heroes.name: Vyper
heroes.note: Rapid-fire poison assassin who slides through fights. Mobile burst, but squishy when pinned down.

heroes.name: Warden
heroes.note: Duellist carry who wants to end in 20–30 min (53.6% win rate there, 48.6% in 40+ min games). Alchemical Flask binds, Last Stand cleanses — don't let him reach his ~22 min Mercurial Magnum spike comfortably.

heroes.name: Wraith
heroes.note: S-tier duellist. Card Trick homing cards, a teleport with a bullet shield, and Telekinesis lifts one target for a stun — she isolates and deletes one person, then leaves.

heroes.name: Yamato
heroes.note: Relentless pursuer with self-heal. Flying Slash range was cut to 23m on 30 Oct — she has to commit further to reach you now.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target. +20% Weapon Damage within 15m. Also grants +20% Melee Resist.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.desc: +30% Max Ammo and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals +45 bonus weapon damage (9s cooldown). Also grants +30 Bonus Health.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.desc: +45% Bullet Velocity and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.desc: +25% Weapon Damage vs. NPCs, +25% Bullet Resist vs. NPCs, and +1 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.desc: +9% Fire Rate.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.desc: Your next bullet heals you: 50 from heroes, 20 from NPCs/Orbs (6s cooldown). Also grants +6% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Active Reload
items.desc: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion instantly finishes your reload and grants +25% Fire Rate, +16% Bullet Lifesteal and +0.75m Move Speed for 7s (12s cooldown). Also grants +20% Max Ammo.

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.desc: Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance. (16s cooldown, 5s duration.)

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.desc: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon, up to +45% max Weapon Damage after 2.5s. Also grants +20% Max Ammo.

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.desc: When you Dash-Jump you gain +25% Fire Rate and +6 bonus Ammo until your next reload, lasting up to 7s. Also grants +1 Stamina and +12% Stamina Recovery.

items.name: Long Range
items.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target: +40% Weapon Damage beyond 15m. Also grants +8% Weapon Fall-off Range and +0.75m Sprint Speed.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals +25% increased damage (5s cooldown). Also grants +50% Heavy Melee Distance, +10% Melee Damage and +6% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.desc: Your next bullet deals +40 bonus Spirit Damage (×0.9 Spirit Power scaling) every 8s. Also grants +7 Spirit Power.

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.desc: Your attacks deal +25% Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health. Also grants +60% Bullet Velocity, +8% Weapon Damage and +7 Spirit Power.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.desc: Dealing 200 weapon damage within 3.5s replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities (25s cooldown). Also grants +20% Max Ammo and +10% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Slowing Bullets
items.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies: -24% Move Speed and -20% Dash Distance for 3.5s.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the target's Spirit Resist by 8% and grants you and your allies +10% Spirit Lifesteal against them for 8s.

items.name: Split Shot
items.desc: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack grants a stacking weapon damage bonus; targets can only be hit once per multishot. (27s cooldown.)

items.name: Stalker
items.desc: Dealing weapon damage within 8m opens a wound: the enemy takes 17 Spirit Damage per second, has -6% Bullet Resist and is revealed through walls for 5s, and you gain +1.5m Move Speed (6s cooldown). Also grants -50% Footstep Sound Distance and +50 Bonus Health.

items.name: Swift Striker
items.desc: +20% Fire Rate and +0.75m Sprint Speed.

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.desc: +100% Max Ammo and +14% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Weakening Headshot
items.desc: Landing a headshot reduces the enemy's Bullet Resist by 12% for 12s. Also grants +60 Bonus Health.

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.desc: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. 50% less effective vs non-heroes. (30s cooldown, 5s duration, 10m range.)

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +22% range. Dealing damage with that ability grants +20% Weapon Damage per unique hero hit for 20s (max 3 hero stacks; reduced effect on non-heroes).

items.name: Berserker
items.desc: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage: +7% Weapon Damage per stack (120 damage taken per stack, up to 10 stacks, 10s duration). Also grants +8% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.desc: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve Fire Rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.desc: When one of your bullets hits a hero, briefly gain +32% Fire Rate and +1.25m Move Speed for 4.5s (9s cooldown). Also grants +50% Slide Distance and +10% Fire Rate.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.desc: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff. (270s cooldown, 160s duration, 7m range.)

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.desc: Grants +2% Bullet Resist per stack when your bullets hit a hero (max 30%, 24s stack duration). Also grants +35% Max Ammo, +75 Bonus Health and +18% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Express Shot
items.desc: Your next attack fires twice in quick succession with +125% Weapon Damage and +100% Bullet Velocity, consuming 2 extra ammo (8s cooldown). Also grants +60% Bullet Velocity and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Headhunter
items.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals +75 bonus weapon damage, heals you for 4% of your max health and grants +1.75m Move Speed for 3s (8s cooldown). Also grants +5% Weapon Damage and +50 Bonus Health.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.desc: Provides Move Speed and Fire Rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value. Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. (22s cooldown, 7s duration, 35m range.)

items.name: Hollow Point
items.desc: When you are above 65% health, deal +35% Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist by 10% for 8s. Also grants +4.5 Out of Combat Regen and +125 Bonus Health.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.desc: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist by 10% and Fire Rate by 15% within 15m; doubled if only one enemy hero is nearby. Also grants +100 Bonus Health and +0.75m Sprint Speed.

items.name: Point Blank
items.desc: When within 15m of your target, gain +50% Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a -20% Move Speed slow for 2.5s. Also grants +75 Bonus Health and +30% Melee Resist.

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.desc: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. (37s cooldown, 13s duration.)

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.desc: Deal +60% Weapon Damage when beyond 15m from your target. Also grants +18% Weapon Fall-off Range, +25% Weapon Zoom, +60% Bullet Velocity, +10% Weapon Damage and +1m Sprint Speed, but -0.7m Move Speed.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the target's Spirit Resist by 8% and grants you and your allies +10% Spirit Lifesteal against them. Landing headshots reduces their Spirit Resist by a further 7% per stack (up to 4 stacks, 8s duration). Also grants +75 Bonus Health.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.desc: Your bullets have a 15% chance to shock your target for 33 Spirit Damage, jumping to up to 4 nearby enemies within 8m.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.desc: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, dealing 1.9% of their Max Health per second and reducing their Incoming Healing by 40% for 4s.

items.name: Weighted Shots
items.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies: -24% Move Speed and -20% Dash Distance for 3.5s. Also grants +30% Weapon Damage and +22% Debuff Resist, but -14% Stamina Recovery and -0.5m Move Speed.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.desc: Your bullets have a 60% chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance. Also grants +60% Bullet Velocity and +8% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Capacitor
items.desc: Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities. (40s cooldown.)

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.desc: Landing a headshot reduces the enemy's Bullet Resist by 16%, Spirit Resist by 16% and Incoming Healing by 40% for 12s. Also grants +125 Bonus Health.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals +25% increased damage (5s cooldown). Your melee damage restores 15% ammo and applies a stacking -5% Bullet Resist debuff (up to 6 stacks, 8s duration); at max stacks the enemy is stunned for 0.75s. Also grants +60% Heavy Melee Distance, +22% Melee Damage and +12% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Frenzy
items.desc: While you are below 50% health, gain +4m/s Move Speed, +40% Fire Rate and +40% Debuff Resist for 10s, and existing debuffs on you are reduced (16s cooldown). Also grants +160 Bonus Health, +15% Fire Rate and +10% Bullet Lifesteal.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.desc: Each hero kill grants +7% Fire Rate permanently (up to 8 stacks); death loses 1 stack. Also grants +85% Weapon Damage but -13% Max Health.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.desc: Your bullets have a 25% chance to be empowered, dealing +100% bonus weapon damage on hit (bonus damage cannot Crit). Also grants +30% Max Ammo.

items.name: Ricochet
items.desc: Your bullets ricochet onto up to 2 enemies near your target within 13m, dealing 65% of the original damage and applying bullet procs. Also grants +18% Fire Rate.

items.name: Silencer
items.desc: Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing Spirit Damage by 25% for 6s, and build up to a 2.5s Silence (victims are immune to build-up for 10s after silence expires). Also grants +12% Spirit Resist.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.desc: While in-combat, whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff: +11% Fire Rate and -10% Reload Time per stack (up to 6 stacks, 18s duration, each stack refreshes the duration). Also grants +5% Ability Cooldown Reduction.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.desc: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes: +25% Fire Rate, +30 Spirit Power and +10% Spirit Lifesteal for 15s. Also grants +13% Ability Duration, +15% Spirit Lifesteal, +90 Bonus Health and +8 Spirit Power.

items.name: Extra Health
items.desc: +210 Max Health.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.desc: +2.5 Health Regen and +1.5 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.desc: +1 Stamina and +12% Stamina Recovery.

items.name: Grit
items.desc: Gain a Barrier for a short duration. (60s cooldown.)

items.name: Healing Rite
items.desc: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast. (70s cooldown, 30m range.)

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.desc: Your next Melee attack heals you for 100 (30% effective vs non-heroes; 8s cooldown, 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits). Also grants +12% Melee Damage.

items.name: Rebuttal
items.desc: On a successful parry against an enemy hero, heal for 100% of the damage parried, return that damage to the target, and gain +30% bonus damage for 6s. Also grants -1.25s Parry Cooldown, +18% Melee Resist and +75 Bonus Health.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.desc: +2m Sprint Speed and +2 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.desc: While above 65% health, gain +22% Weapon Damage and +7% Fire Rate. Also grants +18% Bullet Resist and +3 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.desc: Heal for 15% of the weapon damage you deal. Also grants +90 Bonus Health and +10% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.desc: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you by 25%. Also grants +90 Bonus Health.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.desc: While above 65% health, gain +15 Spirit Power and +5% Ability Cooldown Reduction. Also grants +18% Spirit Resist and +2 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.desc: Enemy move speed penalties are 25% less effective on you. Also grants +2m Move Speed and +2 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.desc: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else. (60s cooldown, 40m range.)

items.name: Healbane
items.desc: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing by 35% for 8s; if an enemy hero dies under the effect, heal for 170. Also grants +7 Spirit Power.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing by 20%. Also grants +2 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.desc: Gain a 325 Barrier for 10s when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced (55s cooldown). Also grants +1 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Restorative Locket
items.desc: When an enemy uses an ability within 32m of you, store one Restoration Stack. Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have. (20s cooldown, 32m range.)

items.name: Return Fire
items.desc: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon. (23s cooldown, 6.5s duration.)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.desc: Heal for 15% of the spirit damage you deal. Also grants +90 Bonus Health and +8 Spirit Power.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.desc: Taking 225 spirit damage from enemy heroes within 3.5s grants a 300 Barrier and +15% Spirit Resist for 8s (45s cooldown). Also grants +2.5 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.desc: Each assist or kill grants +0.15m Sprint Speed, +0.75% Ability Range and +16 Souls per minute (stacks up to 16, persists through death). Also grants +2m Sprint Speed and +2 Out of Combat Regen, but -15% Weapon Damage vs NPCs.

items.name: Weapon Shielding
items.desc: Taking 250 weapon damage from enemy heroes within 4s grants a 300 Barrier and +18% Bullet Resist for 8s (35s cooldown). Also grants +2.5 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.desc: When below 50% health, gain +15% Bullet Resist (for a combined 50% total). Also grants +35% Bullet Resist and +5 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Counterspell
items.desc: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items for 0.8s; a successful spell parry heals you for 150 and grants +20 Spirit Power and +1.75m Move Speed for 6s (23s cooldown). Also grants +50 Bonus Health and +5 Spirit Power.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.desc: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept. (52s cooldown.)

items.name: Fortitude
items.desc: After 10s without taking damage, regenerate 2.25% of your max health per second. While above 75% health, gain +1.5m Move Speed. Also grants +375 Bonus Health.

items.name: Fury Trance
items.desc: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration. (18s cooldown, 6.5s duration.)

items.name: Healing Nova
items.desc: Heal yourself and nearby allies. (60s cooldown.)

items.name: Lifestrike
items.desc: Your melee attacks apply a -48% move slow for 2.5s and heal you for 120 plus 35% of the melee damage dealt (40% effective vs non-heroes; 4s cooldown, 1.5x longer for light melee). Also grants +16% Melee Damage and +125 Bonus Health.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.desc: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero. (45s cooldown.)

items.name: Metal Skin
items.desc: Become immune to bullets. (24s cooldown, 5s duration.)

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.desc: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast. (60s cooldown, 35m range.)

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.desc: When below 50% health, gain +15% Spirit Resist (for a combined 45% total). Also grants +30% Spirit Resist and +3 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.desc: Gain an additional Air Jump or Air Dash before landing. Also grants +2 Stamina, +18% Stamina Recovery and +23% Air Jump/Dash Distance.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.desc: Walking through a cosmic veil grants 8s of invisibility, +3.5m move speed and heals you for 85 (15s cooldown). Also grants +125 Bonus Health and +6 Spirit Power.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.desc: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist. (16s cooldown, 11m range.)

items.name: Cheat Death
items.desc: When you would take lethal damage, become death immune for 4.5s and remove all non-stun debuffs; while immune you deal 60% less damage and receive 60% less healing (105s cooldown). Also grants +200 Bonus Health and +15% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Colossus
items.desc: Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage. Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed. (37s cooldown, 7s duration, 14m range.)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.desc: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else. (55s cooldown, 40m range.)

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.desc: Casting your ultimate grants a 1000 Barrier and +40 Spirit Power for 20s (40s cooldown). Also grants +15% Ability Duration and +10% Ultimate Cooldown Reduction.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.desc: Healing yourself or an ally grants them +35% Fire Rate and +1.25m Move Speed for 7s (does not trigger from regen or lifesteal). Also grants +25% Outgoing Healing, +10% Spirit Resist, +6 Health Regen and +4 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Indomitable
items.desc: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep, Silence or Fear on you is automatically cleansed; when it happens you gain a 325 Barrier for 10s and all your ability cooldowns are reduced by 20% (55s cooldown). Also grants +10% Bullet Resist, +10% Spirit Resist and +2 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Infuser
items.desc: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power. (30s cooldown, 7s duration.)

items.name: Inhibitor
items.desc: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage by 30% and their Incoming Healing by 40% for 5s. Also grants +10% Weapon Damage and +150 Bonus Health.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.desc: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed by 40% for 4s. Also grants +50% Slow Resist, +2.5m Move Speed, +25% Melee Resist and +15 Health Regen.

items.name: Leech
items.desc: Heal for 30% of the weapon damage and 30% of the spirit damage you deal. Also grants +180 Bonus Health, +12% Weapon Damage and +12 Spirit Power.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.desc: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm. (35s cooldown, 25m range.)

items.name: Plated Armor
items.desc: 30% chance to deflect incoming bullets (preventing all weapon damage) and a 50% chance to prevent all on-hit effects from bullets. Also grants +130 Bonus Health.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.desc: Your bullets steal 2.5% of an enemy's Max HP for 17s, granting you the same amount of max HP (1.2s cooldown; enemies regain the stolen health when it expires). Also grants +15% Weapon Damage and +10% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.desc: The next instance of spirit damage over 175 is reduced by 65% (9s cooldown). Also grants +18% Spirit Resist, +25% Debuff Resist and +90 Bonus Health.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.desc: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept. (60s cooldown, 5.5s duration.)

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.desc: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size. (30s cooldown, 5s duration.)

items.name: Witchmail
items.desc: Taking a hit of 75 or more spirit damage reduces a random ability's cooldown by 4s (1s cooldown). Also grants +22% Spirit Resist and +14 Spirit Power.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.desc: +1 charge for your charged abilities and +7 Spirit Power for charged abilities.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.desc: +10 Spirit Power.

items.name: Golden Goose Egg
items.desc: Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs. The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched. Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.desc: Charges up over 14s; your next ability dealing more than 80 damage deals +40 bonus spirit damage.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +20% range and effect radius.

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.desc: Dealing spirit damage to enemy heroes grants you 4 HP/s regeneration for 7s (stacks across different heroes). Also grants +50 Bonus Health.

items.name: Rusted Barrel
items.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance. (16s cooldown, 5s duration, 32m range.)

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.desc: Your melee attacks against heroes deal +40 bonus spirit damage and reduce their Spirit Resist by 6% for 6s (8s cooldown, 2x longer for light melee).

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.desc: After a Dash-Jump, the next ability you cast within 7s gains +12% Ability Range, +15% Ability Duration and +20 Spirit Power. Also grants +1 Stamina and +12% Stamina Recovery.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.desc: Dealing spirit damage reduces the enemy's Bullet Resist by 10% for 8s. Also grants +9% Bullet Resist and +9% Weapon Damage.

items.name: Cold Front
items.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits. (25s cooldown, 4s duration, 10m range.)

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +18% Ability Cooldown Reduction.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +22% Ability Duration.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.desc: +18 Spirit Power and +1.5 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.desc: Enemies that take spirit damage from you have their Move Speed reduced by 24% and Dash Distance by 12% for 2s. Also grants +50 Bonus Health and +0.75m Sprint Speed.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.desc: Enemies that take spirit damage from you have their Spirit Resist reduced by 8% for 7s. Also grants +8% Spirit Resist.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over 18s; casting it deals +44 bonus spirit damage, grants +10% Fire Rate and fully reloads your weapon.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.desc: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage. (29s cooldown, 3.5s duration, 25m range.)

items.name: Spirit Sap
items.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power. (22s cooldown, 12s duration, 35m range.)

items.name: Suppressor
items.desc: Dealing spirit damage also reduces the enemy's Fire Rate by 28% for 4.5s. Also grants +6 Spirit Power and +8% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Decay
items.desc: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs. (30s cooldown, 12s duration, 20m range.)

items.name: Disarming Hex
items.desc: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist. (16s cooldown, 4.25s duration, 32m range.)

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.desc: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items by 30%. Also grants +10% Spirit Resist.

items.name: Knockdown
items.desc: Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun. (35s cooldown, 45m range.)

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.desc: Dealing spirit damage to enemy heroes grants +4 HP/s regeneration for 7s (stacks across different heroes). While in combat, casting an ability heals you for 40 and grants +1.75m Move Speed for 3s (6s cooldown). Also grants +90 Bonus Health.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.desc: +2 charges for your charged abilities, +30% faster time between charges, +14% Cooldown Reduction for charged abilities and +14 Spirit Power for charged abilities.

items.name: Silence Wave
items.desc: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities. (42s cooldown, 3s duration, 40m range.)

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.desc: Your melee attacks against a hero deal +50 bonus spirit damage and steal 12% Spirit Resist and 25 Spirit Power for 10s (6s cooldown; effects reduced by 30% for light melee). Also grants +7% Melee Damage and +75 Bonus Health.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.desc: +20% Ability Cooldown Reduction. Also grants +4 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.desc: Increases the duration of your abilities and items by 28%. Also grants +8% Bullet Resist.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +28 Spirit Power. Using that ability grants +20% Fire Rate and +1.75m Move Speed for 8s (14s cooldown).

items.name: Tankbuster
items.desc: Charges up over 14s; abilities dealing more than 165 damage deal +40 bonus spirit damage plus 7.5% of the target's current health, ignoring Spirit Resistance. Also grants +50 Bonus Health.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.desc: Every 1.4s, deals 25 spirit damage to the two closest enemies within 9m. Also grants +100 Bonus Health and +22% Melee Resist.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen. (24s cooldown, 16m range.)

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.desc: +30 Spirit Power plus 15% of your current Spirit Power, +75 Bonus Health and +4 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.desc: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs. Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration. (55s cooldown, 3.25s duration, 20m range.)

items.name: Echo Shard
items.desc: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability. (30s cooldown.)

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.desc: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp: +4.5% spirit damage to that target per stack (up to 12 stacks, 12s duration). Also grants +17% Spirit Resist; your spirit damage also reduces the target's Spirit Resist by 8%.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.desc: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration. (37s cooldown, 4s duration.)

items.name: Focus Lens
items.desc: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off. (40s cooldown, 4.5s duration, 25m range.)

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.desc: Damage from your ultimate stuns the target for 0.75s and deals 150 bonus spirit damage after a 3s delay (once per target per ultimate). Your spirit damage also slows enemies by 24% Move Speed and 12% Dash Distance. Also grants +50 Bonus Health and +0.75m Sprint Speed.

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.desc: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned. (32s cooldown, 12s duration.)

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over 14s; on use it deals +60 bonus spirit damage, grants +22% Fire Rate and reloads your weapon, and until your next reload your bullets deal bonus spirit damage equal to 20% of base bullet damage. Also grants +20% Max Ammo and +7 Spirit Power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.desc: Imbue an ability with +22% Lifesteal: hitting an enemy marks them, and after 3s an explosion deals 50% of the damage dealt to enemies within 16m and slows them by 32% (6.25s cooldown). Also grants +8% Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Refresher
items.desc: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges. (300s cooldown.)

items.name: Scourge
items.desc: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast. (35s cooldown, 10s duration, 35m range.)

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.desc: Dealing 500 spirit damage to an enemy within 5s triggers an explosion for 50 damage and a burn dealing 24 spirit damage per second and reducing their Incoming Healing by 70% for 7s (20s immunity per target). Also grants +6% Ability Range.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.desc: +25% Ability Cooldown Reduction and +25% Item Cooldown Reduction. Also grants +4 Out of Combat Regen.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.desc: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex. Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly. (42s cooldown, 4s duration, 30m range.)

Toxic Bullets.desc: Your bullets build a bleed for 1.9% of the target's max HP per second and cut their incoming healing — current sources disagree on the exact cut (−35% vs −40%), so check the live shop tooltip. The standard gun answer to sustain.

Decay.desc: Active: damage over time based on the target's current health, with the strongest targeted healing cut at Tier 3 — sources disagree on the exact figure (−50% vs −55% for 12s), so check the live shop tooltip. Melts tanks and healers alike.

Healbane.desc: Cheap Tier 2 anti-heal: −35% healing for 8s on spirit damage. Stacks now diminish hard after the 4 Nov patch — Valve's numbers: 2 stacks ≈54.7%, 4 stacks ≈72%. One or two per team is enough; a third adds very little.

Spirit Burn.desc: Tier 4 spirit burst and the strongest anti-heal item in the current shop — an S-tier item by win rate in Nov 2026. The late-game answer when a healer is carrying fights.

Crippling Headshot.desc: Headshots apply 40% healing reduction and cripple the target (buffed on 30 Oct). A late-game gun answer to a fed sustain carry you can reliably headshot.

Metal Skin.desc: Active (24s CD): immune to bullets for 5s. On-hit bullet effects still apply, but raw gun damage — Bullet Dance, Full Auto, a fed crossbow — simply stops. Time it for their burst window.

Bullet Resilience.desc: +35% Bullet Resist (raised on 30 Oct), and stronger below half health. The always-on answer when a gun carry is your problem in every fight, not just one window.

Return Fire.desc: Active (23s CD): for 6.5s you auto-fire back at attackers who damage you with weapons or abilities. Cheap Tier 2 punishment for a rapid-fire hero who has to keep shooting you.

Hunter's Aura.desc: Enemies within 15m in line of sight lose 10% Bullet Resist and 15% Fire Rate (doubled against a lone hero). Since 30 Oct it no longer works through walls — but a stealther has to come into the open to hit you.

Stalker.desc: Weapon damage within 8m wounds the target: spirit damage over time, −6% Bullet Resist, and revealed through walls for 5s. Stealth doesn't help them once you've tagged them.

Spirit Resilience.desc: +30% Spirit Resist, plus another 15% while you're below 50% health. The always-on answer to spirit burst and burn builds.

Counterspell.desc: Your parry becomes a spell parry (23s CD): block one ability or item outright, and on success heal 150 and gain Spirit Power and move speed. The skill-shot answer to one big, telegraphed ability.

Spellbreaker.desc: Tier 4 spirit defence — the late-game upgrade when a spirit carry is deleting you through Tier 3 resists.

Dispel Magic.desc: Active (52s CD): purge all non-ultimate debuffs on yourself; if anything was removed, heal 250 and gain move speed. Cannot be used while stunned or asleep — pop it for slows, burns, hexes and marks, before the stun lands.

Debuff Reducer.desc: Cheap Tier 2 debuff duration reduction. The budget answer when one enemy's slows, burns or marks are ruining your fights.

Unstoppable.desc: Active (60s CD): for 5.5s you're immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root and Disarm, and suppress negative effects. Can't be cast while already stunned — press it as their engage starts, not after.

Reactive Barrier.desc: Tier 2 barrier that triggers when you're hit by crowd control or burst. Cheap insurance for the first second of an engage, while your real answer comes off cooldown.

Knockdown.desc: Active (35s CD, 45m range): after a 2s delay the target is stunned — longer against airborne targets, with increased gravity. Grounds flyers, and interrupts channels it lands on.

Phantom Strike.desc: Active (35s CD, 25m range): teleport to an enemy, pull them to the ground, and apply damage, a move-speed reduction and a disarm. The hard answer to a hero who lives in the sky.

Capacitor.desc: Active (40s CD): a projectile dealing spirit damage with a strong recovering slow that blocks Stamina use and silences movement items and abilities. They can't dash, blink or leap out of it.

Slowing Hex.desc: Cheap Tier 2 active slow that also shuts down movement items and abilities while it's on the target — Warp Stone is silenced under it, and it even interrupts Mirage's Traveler channel.

Slowing Bullets.desc: Your bullets build up to −24% Move Speed and −20% Dash Distance for 3.5s. Sustained gunfire pins a mobile hero in place for your team.

Inhibitor.desc: Tier 4: hitting enemies slows them and reduces the damage they deal. The late-game answer when a mobile carry is both uncatchable and out-damaging you.

Cursed Relic.desc: Active (55s CD, 20m range): for 3.25s the target is interrupted, silenced, disarmed, blocked from using items, and stripped of non-ult buffs — at the cost of your own damage. The full shutdown button for one problem hero.

Silence Wave.desc: Active (42s CD): an expanding projectile that silences everything it passes through, plus impact damage. It doesn't interrupt channels already running — fire it before their combo starts.

Focus Lens.desc: Active (40s CD, 25m range): silence one target for 4.5s, and a portion of the damage they take during the silence lands when it ends. Single-target deletion setup.

Silencer.desc: Tier 4 gun item whose bullets proc silence. A gun carry's way to shut down an ability-dependent hero without spending an active slot.

Escalating Exposure.desc: Repeated spirit hits stack escalating spirit amplification on the target. The core of the current spirit meta — and how a spirit hero melts a tank who stacked health instead of resists.

Spirit Rend.desc: Your bullets shred Spirit Resist (−8%, with headshots stacking −7% more, up to 4 stacks) and grant Spirit Lifesteal against the target. Builds out of Spirit Shredder. Opens a spirit-resistant tank up for your whole team.

Warp Stone.desc: Active (16s CD): blink 11m and gain +30% Bullet Resist for 6s. Reposition out of a sniper's sightline or a dive's landing spot, on a short cooldown.

Ethereal Shift.desc: Active (37s CD): enter a void state for 4s — untouchable while a burst combo or a channeled ult passes through you. The late-game dodge.

Colossus.desc: Active (37s CD): grow 20% larger for 7s with +35% Bullet and Spirit Resist, +30% Melee Damage and +25% Base Health, slowing nearby enemies. Stand your ground through their spike instead of running from it.

Cheat Death.desc: Passive (105s CD): when you would die, you instead survive with 4.5s of death immunity and clear non-stun debuffs — at −60% damage and healing during it. Buys the one extra life a focused target needs.

Divine Barrier.desc: Active (55s CD since 30 Oct, 40m range): cleanse non-stun debuffs on a target, grant a 600 Barrier and move speed. Cooldown halved when cast on an ally. The support's save button.

Rescue Beam.desc: Active (60s CD, 35m range): channel 2.5s to heal an ally and yourself for 20% of max HP each, and once per channel pull that ally toward you — out of the ult, out of the dive.

Rusted Barrel.desc: Tier 1: spirit damage cuts the target's fire rate by 32% for 5s. The cheapest pro answer to a gun laner — buy it in lane, before their build snowballs.

Suppressor.desc: Tier 2: your spirit damage cuts enemy fire rate by 28%. The sustained version of Rusted Barrel for spirit heroes laning into gun carries.

Weapon Shielding.desc: +18% Bullet Resist plus a 300 barrier. Tier 2 bullet defence the pro guides reach for against gun builds.

Battle Vest.desc: +18% Bullet Resist at Tier 2 — flat, always-on gun defence.

Plated Armor.desc: Tier 4: 30% of bullets bounce off you and half of on-hit effects are blocked. The late, chance-based answer to rapid-fire and on-hit builds — and to Haze's Fixation stacking.

Juggernaut.desc: Tier 4: enemies who shoot you lose 40% fire rate. Punishes a fed gun carry for doing the only thing their build does.

Disarming Hex.desc: Active: disarm the target for 4.25s and cut their Bullet Resist by 13%. A teammate-applied stop button for a fed gun carry — it does NOT stop a channel already running, like Haze's Bullet Dance.

Spirit Shielding.desc: +15% Spirit Resist plus a 300 barrier. The Tier 2 lane answer to spirit burst and poke.

Enchanter's Emblem.desc: +18% Spirit Resist at Tier 2 — flat spirit defence while you build to Spirit Resilience.

Spirit Sap.desc: Cuts the target's Spirit Power by 30 and their Spirit Resist by 9% for 12s. Turns down a spirit build's damage at the source.

Witchmail.desc: +22% Spirit Resist at Tier 4 — late-game spirit defence.

Indomitable.desc: Automatically cleanses the next stun, sleep, silence, root or fear and grants a barrier — no reaction needed. The pro answer to surprise catches (Sleep Dagger, Lasso, Wraith's ult lift) where you can't press Unstoppable in time. Not a reliable escape from Dynamo's Singularity. It also blocks Baba's Feed The Birds pigeon transformation (26 Nov).

Mystic Slow.desc: Your spirit damage slows. The spirit-side version of Slowing Bullets for pinning mobile heroes.

Tankbuster.desc: Your abilities deal bonus spirit damage plus 7.5% of the target's current health against high-health targets. Percentage damage doesn't care how much health they bought.

Armor Piercer.desc: Tier 4: 60% of your bullets ignore Bullet Resist and barriers. The gun answer to a tank who stacked resist instead of health.

Siphon Bullets.desc: Tier 4: steal max health from enemies you hit. Shrinks a health-stack tank's bar while growing yours.

Spirit Shredder.desc: Tier 2 bullets shred Spirit Resist — the component that builds into Spirit Rend, and a cheap way to open a tank up for your team's spirit damage.

Ricochet.desc: Tier 4: your shots bounce between enemies. Late-game summon and grouped-team clear — the pro guides only suggest it on gun builds that already want it.

Monster Rounds.desc: Tier 1 bonus damage against non-hero units — summons, ghouls, turrets, Little Helpers. The cheap early clear for summoner heroes.

Rebuttal.desc: Tier 1: parry cooldown −1.75s, +18% melee resist, and a landed parry heals you and returns damage. The pro answer to readable melee brawlers.

Extra Stamina.desc: Tier 1 extra stamina charge. Cheap dodges out of slows, roots, walls and telegraphed setups.

Stamina Mastery.desc: Tier 3 stamina upgrade — more dashes to cross portal exits, walls and zoning squares alive.

Enduring Speed.desc: Tier 2 slow resistance and move speed. Keeps you moving through Scrap Grenades and slow fields.

Restorative Locket.desc: Tier 2 stored healing you release when you need it — sustain through a poke lane that would otherwise cost you farm.

Abrams: Siphon Life heals Abrams for the damage he deals to everyone around him — Decay's 55% healing cut plus percentage damage is the direct answer to that brawl.
Abrams only drains what he can touch. A stacking slow keeps the melee brawler at arm's length while your team burns him down.
Your bullets keep the anti-heal on him between Decay casts — his sustain never gets a clean window.
Apollo: Apollo's game is Riposte, dashes and stamina. Capacitor's projectile blocks Stamina and silences movement abilities — the escape kit simply stops working.
Slowed and dash-cut, Apollo has to win a fair gunfight instead of dancing around one.
Tier 4: slows him and cuts his damage — the late answer to a fed mobile carry.
Baba: Baba stacks health and resists, and her Spirit Resist scaling was cut again on 26 Nov — stacking spirit amplification burns through the frontline build.
Her Brew cycles spirit damage and burns — resists blunt every rotation, not one window.
Shred her Spirit Resist with your bullets so your whole team's spirit damage lands on the tank.
Bebop: Hyper Beam is a channel, and Bebop stands still to fire it — Knockdown's delayed stun lands and ends the beam, hook combo and all.
If the Grapple Arm lands anyway, void out for 4s and let the entire Hyper Beam fire at nothing.
A spell parry on the hook timing deletes his one pick play.
Billy: Chain Gang wants to drag you into a brawl on Billy's terms — 5.5s of stun/root immunity lets you walk out of the setup.
A slowed Billy can't force the melee range his whole kit needs.
If the brawl happens anyway, Colossus lets you stand in it with +35% resists.
Calico: Calico's whole game is one burst combo on an isolated target — the barrier eats its first second, and she's squishy once it whiffs.
Blocks her stamina and silences her movement abilities — the burst assassin has to stay and fight.
Five seconds of bullet immunity covers her entire combo window.
Celeste: Dazzling Trick's silence and her dagger marks are non-ultimate debuffs — Dispel Magic purges them and heals you 250 mid-fight.
Radiant Daggers stack Spirit Amp — resists are the always-on answer to her burst.
Parry the Dazzling Trick cast and her combo loses its opener.
Deadman Danny: Danny fights from a jetpack — Knockdown's stun lasts longer vs airborne targets and slams him out of the sky.
Teleport up to him, pull him to the ground and disarm him — Close The Deal can't carry a grounded Danny.
Blocks stamina and silences movement abilities, so the jetpack kit can't reposition out.
The Doorman: Hotel Guest is one telegraphed cast that removes a target from the fight — a spell parry eats it entirely.
His Doorway setups end in crowd control — immunity lets your team play through the portal engage.
He heals his team through long fights — anti-heal on the focus target cuts the value of every save.
Drifter: Drifter picks off isolated targets and slips away — Slowing Hex silences his movement abilities, so the slip-away never fires.
The barrier eats the first second of his ambush combo — the difference between a trade and a death recap.
No stamina, no movement abilities: the roaming assassin has to walk home.
Dynamo: Singularity is a channel — Cursed Relic interrupts the best teamfight ult in the game and item-blocks the follow-up.
Rejuvenating Aurora heals his whole team through the fight — anti-heal on your focus target cuts all of it.
Fire it into his team as the fight starts so the Aurora and follow-up casts come late.
Graves: Graves' damage is lingering burn and ghoul pressure — Dispel Magic purges the debuffs and heals you through the attrition.
Shorter burns, shorter marks — cheap Tier 2 relief against a DoT hero who wins long fights.
Her lock-on damage is spirit-scaled — resists blunt the poke she wins lanes with.
Grey Talon: Grey Talon folds when dived — Phantom Strike teleports you onto him and disarms him. His whole game is distance; delete it.
Blink out of the bow's sightline or straight into his face — either way his range advantage is gone.
His poke is spirit-scaled — resists take the sting out of the lane.
Haze: One tag reveals Haze through walls for 5s — Sleep Dagger ambushes stop working the moment she's marked.
Bullet Dance is a point-blank channel — Cursed Relic interrupts it and disarms her mid-dance.
She has to come within 15m to kill you — inside the aura her Fire Rate and Bullet Resist are already cut.
Holliday: Holliday's catch is the kill — stun immunity lets you play through the engage her whole kit is built around.
Cheap insurance for the first second of her burst combo while your real answer comes online.
Purge the marks and slows her catch leaves on you — before the follow-up lands.
Infernus: Afterburn is a purgeable burn — Dispel Magic clears it and heals 250, and short fights are fights his Napalm lifesteal can't win.
Napalm's Tier 2 lifesteal (20% since 30 Oct) keeps him alive while he dives — 40% anti-heal is how the dive ends.
Shorter burns, and his delayed Concussive Combustion stun loses its setup.
Ivy: Air Drop flies a teammate — or a Stone Form — in from the sky. Knockdown grounds airborne targets with a longer stun.
Kudzu Connection tethers heals to her ally — anti-heal cuts the save she's flying in to deliver.
Pull Ivy herself out of the sky and disarm her — the rescue pilot becomes the target.
Kelvin: Frozen Shelter wins by out-healing you inside the dome — anti-heal is how dome fights actually end.
His damage inside the dome is spirit — resists let you contest the dome instead of conceding it.
Dome fights are long fights — stacking spirit amp melts the support who wants to stall them.
Lady Geist: Life Drain heals her for 100% of the damage it deals — Decay's 55% cut plus percentage damage breaks the tether maths completely.
Void out for the Soul Exchange window — she can't swap health with a target who isn't there.
Keeps anti-heal on her between Decay casts, so Life Drain never gets a full-value fight.
Lash: Death Slam comes from directly above — Knockdown punishes airborne targets with a longer stun and slams him down.
Teleport to him mid-air, pull him to the ground and disarm — the aerial engage becomes your engage.
Blink out of the slam's landing spot as he commits — his whole combo is aimed at where you were.
McGinnis: Heavy Barrage is an 8-second channel from the slowest hero in the game — interrupt it and McGinnis is a turret with legs.
Knockdown's delayed stun lands on a stationary, channelling McGinnis every single time.
Medicinal Specter heals her team through the barrage — anti-heal cuts the stall her turrets want.
Mina: Rake slashes and heals her, Love Bites stack on every gun hit — 40% anti-heal is what makes the glass cannon stay glass.
Blocks her stamina and silences movement abilities — the oppressive lane bully can't dance out of a bad fight.
Her burst window fits inside Metal Skin's 5 seconds of bullet immunity.
Mirage: Traveler is now a 3s channel — and Slowing Hex interrupts it. His escape-and-stun play just fizzles.
Pinned and dash-cut, Mirage has to win a straight fight instead of vanishing out of one.
Parry the Traveler or his engage cast and his one reposition is gone.
Mo & Krill: Scorn heals him 1.3× from heroes and Combo keeps stacking his health — percentage damage plus 55% anti-heal answers both.
Your bullets keep the anti-heal up through every Burrow engage, so Scorn never gets a full-value brawl.
A slowed Mo & Krill can't force the close range Scorn and Combo need.
Nurse Harrow: Leech Therapy drains you to feed her whole team — anti-heal on her target cuts every heal the drain produces.
Purge the drain and terror debuffs she leaves on your team — just don't wait until the fear has you running.
Her damage is spirit — resists blunt the poke that builds her fear.
Paige: Plot Armor is one button that saves her carry — silence Paige for 4.5s and the save never gets pressed. Catch her, not her carry.
Silence, disarm and item-block in one cast — Paige watches the fight she was supposed to fix.
She's low-mobility — a slowed Paige can't reposition to save anyone.
Paradox: Paradoxical Swap is one telegraphed cast — a spell parry eats it, and the pick play into his whole team disappears.
If the swap lands anyway, blink 11m out of his team and pick up +30% Bullet Resist doing it.
His follow-up is crowd control — immunity covers everything after the swap itself.
Pocket: Pocket's combo ends with a movement-ability escape — Capacitor silences it and blocks stamina, so the burst hero has to stay for the reply.
His zone control and burst are spirit — resists blunt the combo he has nothing without.
Void out the burst window; his long cooldowns mean there's no second combo coming.
Rat King: Rule, Ratannia! gives his whole team damage reduction — stacking spirit amplification is how you burn through a damage-reduced frontline.
He stands in front and soaks — shred his Spirit Resist and your team's spirit damage does what bullets can't.
Percentage damage doesn't care how tanky the Rat King bought himself.
Rem: Unstoppable's immunity list literally includes Sleep — Rem's dream setup bounces off it for 5.5s.
Rem's team saves heal through long games — anti-heal keeps late fights from resetting.
Silence the support whose utility scales with game length, before the save chain starts.
Seven: Storm Cloud is a channel and Seven has no mobility — Cursed Relic interrupts the ult and item-blocks the rest of his kit.
Knockdown's delayed stun lands on a stationary, channelling Seven every time.
Fire it before the combo starts — a silenced Seven is a carry with no buttons.
Shiv: Bloodletting wants a long brawl in Shiv's face — a stacking slow lets you kite the brawl he sustains through.
Percentage damage plus anti-heal — the two things a rage-fuelled sustain tank can't out-heal.
Keeps the anti-heal on him through every trade your team takes.
